reason: Evaluate a fixed same-weight tiled inference option motivated by development-only small-face diagnostics.
within_option_selection: If any threshold reaches both class recall targets, maximize macro precision then minimum class recall then confidence. Otherwise maximize minimum class recall then macro precision then confidence.
between_option_selection: Prefer options reaching both class recall targets. Among eligible options maximize macro precision then minimum class recall; otherwise maximize minimum class recall then macro precision. Exact tie selects standard.
required_before_unsealing: Freeze both option thresholds, model and ONNX hashes, validation hash, and selected option in option-selection-freeze.json.
sealed_until_selection: baseline and regression predictions and metrics
final_app_comparison: Frozen v3 baseline versus validation-selected option on the same 400 new test images, with known-class conditional evaluation; old test is reported separately as regression.
